title: Ìyá Mọòpó
note: The 2016 survey identifies the western sculpture. The overhead film and north-up satellite imagery agree on the open side of the arm fan and the southeast trailing forms. The model’s torso is placed at the estimated fan hub, about 9 m northwest of the survey point, with local +Z facing about 225° true. The satellite streaks may include shadows. The compass bearing, outline and footing heights are approximate. The low wrapper and leg profiles follow sampled native Terrarium elevations at the approximate pose. The apron remains exposed and all five mapped roads, the landcover and the native terrain are preserved in the four viewer detail levels.
